metric_definition.residual: positive underestimate = observed native activity - predicted declared service, divided by selected forwards
metric_definition.body: independent whole-body wall span; family activity gaps must not be added as a body correction
metric_definition.ranking: positive costed activity gaps only, evidence tier explicit; not a ranking of tolerance failures
metric_definition.strict_tolerance: observed<=50us: absolute per-call difference<=15us; observed>50us: relative error<=15%
metric_definition.comparability: Body67 and corrected86 have exact same source/geometry/observed population/case bytes; GLM reference c226 and strict86 are separately identified
metric_definition.missing_prediction: unscored native activity without a prediction is excluded from residual ranking, never treated as zero prediction
metric_definition.runtime_attribution: 67→86 includes multiple changes; only same-runtime candidate-domain controls isolate the83 change
metric_definition.logical96: aeb66892 is a future distinct structure arm; no new structure cost is included here
